name: Collision Auto Parts
old_description: The premier auto body and cooling parts distributor serving Northern California since 2005. We sell certified, as well as non-certified, quality auto body parts from all the top brands at competitive prices. We are fully licensed, insured, and bonded for your peace of mind. Whether you’re installing the body part yourself or trusting your favorite body shop, the money you save means you’ll feel as good as your car will look.
about:
Collision Auto Parts, headquartered in Albuquerque, New Mexico, traces its roots to 2005 when National Auto Parts began serving Northern California. The company rebranded to Collision Auto Parts (COL) and now operates as three entities running distribution facilities across California and New Mexico.

The firm functions as a value-added distributor of certified and non-certified aftermarket collision repair parts. Its product lineup spans bumper covers, grilles, fender lines, hoods, headlamps, taillamps, and cooling components such as radiators and AC condensers. Seven distribution centers — located in Sacramento, Santa Rosa, Hayward, Fresno, Calexico, Santa Fe Springs, San Diego, and Albuquerque — support a daily delivery fleet that moves parts to shops throughout the Western U.S. Every component undergoes a 100 percent inspection both on receipt and before shipment.

Customers include national and regional multi-shop operators (MSOs), independent collision repair centers, and do-it-yourself installers. The company emphasizes direct-from-manufacturer purchasing, which it says yields savings of 20 to 80 percent versus original-equipment prices, and it matches competitor list prices.

Collision Auto Parts was built on a philosophy of exceeding customer expectations through honesty, innovation, and continuous improvement. Its stated differentiators include the inspection guarantee, same-day or next-day delivery via its own trucks, CAPA-certified inventory availability, and a technical team that assists with part selection and repair guidance.
